items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: played with Frankie Newton and his band. We played all over in...in the country over there

ctx.x: a month, left outa St. Louis, come back to California. Then I went up in 'Frisco, played up in 'Frisco an' I played up in Oakland, California 'bout three or four months. I met a cat up there called Ernie Williams. He was a piano player, an' I met some o' my old friends from Kansas City. They was there playin' at the same nightclub, an' I left that nightclub, went to another nightclub on the corner 'bout a block-and-a-half from the place where I was workin' at. Worked for Slim Jenkins. He had a nightclub up there.…
